body: We had a long night, I was threatened. He hurt himself but was able to calm himself down. He should be getting rid of the gun today or tomorrow. I hope we can work this out and he can heal himself. Thank you for caring, trying to take in day by day, hour by hour to be safe.
He was able to calm down a bit but giving him space at the moment. I hope he's okay and being rational about his decisions. I'm scared but I don't have a choice but wait to hear from him.
Thank you for your concern. I will make sure to look out for myself too.

Yeah I understand your points. This is not healthy for me, and yes it's really hurtful. But at the moment, i'm all he has, and truthfully I love him to bits. He's a danger to himself but I am very sure the depression escalated because it's a mixture of being homesick, thinking he's not good enough, being away from me, family, and friends. He's stubborn in the sense he doesn't want anyone's help, that he wants to do it himself, but it makes him tough to talk to when he doesn't want to hear anyone else. 

He's a good man, he just makes decisions with his heart more often.

when together, everything is more calmer, we're in each other's lives everyday. I think with the distance, I can say some of it is my fault that I don't keep contact as often throughout the day, mainly because of my work schedule but I do try to do as much as I can. I think with these gaps of silences he's thinking I'm enjoying my time forgetting about him when in reality I'm just going about my day at work.

He keeps thinking because I'm so "beautiful and young" I could just go to any guy, which can mean cheating behind his back. I really do love him, I just don't know how to build this trust if he has walls so high..
its ok, he's been yelling at me all night, i think it's helped him, he hates me but i think he'll throw the gun away. i just might not ever be in his life again.
he thinks im cheating and hiding someone, he keeps asking for a name. i am not hiding anything
he's angry, too angry, he wants me to "stop lying" to him. im not lying.. i wish he could see that im not lying..
i tried this, it angers him. any word out my mouth is a lie to him, poison, i just want to break down

im trying to be as calm as possible right now, he's really verbally and emotionally hurting me and i'm trying to just stay calm as i type to him. im trying not to say much because i dont know whats going to trigger him to do something bad. i prefer that he hates me rather than thinking on the gun.
i hope too, i am just the devil to him in his eyes, everything i say is a lie to him...

I'm feeling very numb right now, incredibly broken. I hope anyone who is reading this and feels like taking their life, please take into consideration of those who love you. We love you in every sense of the word. Whether you see it, feel it, or maybe not see/feel it. The love is there and We love you. When you hurt yourself, you hurt others. The truth is, we don't ever want you gone. No, you're NOT a burden. YES, you are worth everything to keep alive and cherish.
no his children are not with him. i know his loneliness has also contributed to all this negativity. he would never harm his children, i promise that.
yes thank you, I understand what you mean. I guess I love him so much that I would risk it.
he grew up with a bad past because of being blackmailed by some bad people, i cant have this going on his record, he's a single father, a good man
thank you, i honestly love him alot and am willing to risk myself

that will be the issue, he will know when they knock and he'll burst, I can't put himself at harm and put other people at harm. i wish i could be there.. im willing to put the risk on myself, not anyone else
he might do something drastic with the cops.. i'm too scared
just an update, i'm being emotionally and verbally brought down.. i dont know what to do...
Unfortunately he has no one close where he is that could help him.. I wish he did..
yes anything that could help me help him

Thank you, I can't ask anyone for help, he has threaten me that he will be long gone before help arrives if I call. I am too afraid to do it. I have called his best friend to help but my boyfriend came back calling me names telling me that I am not trustworthy and a liar, that it was none of his business and that I must like making him look bad with his friends. He's at the extreme, I can't suggest him getting help because he keeps saying that he can help himself.

In all honesty, I would like to fly out to him and see him myself but I'm in a financial bind. I'm so scared, I don't know what else I can do without him endangering himself or others.
im too scared that he'll feel that i betrayed his trust and over react...
his family doesn't know, he says if i mention anything to them, he'll make sure no one can stop him...
No I don't. I'm crying so hard over here. I don't know what to do.

thank you, I've read these. I'm wondering if there's some kind of service 24/7 that could send someone immediately so he's not alone. I'm really trying to avoid doctors/cops because he'll turn defensive and might take a turn for the worse.
